Articles 281–287, 289, 292, 294 and 295 were upgraded from placeholders to provisional summaries using visible public transcription text. Articles 288, 290, 291 and 293 remain explicitly blocked because the accessible transcription contains editorial placeholders or truncated/uncertain text at those provisions. No attempt was made to reconstruct missing penalty clauses by guesswork. This replaces the earlier block on Articles 288, 290, 291 and 293. Article 289 is the employer fine for breaches of Articles 62–66; Article 291 is the unlicensed recruitment / improper collection offence. Keep them provisional until comparison with the Gazette image and legal review.
